1 مَا سَكِفْتُ البَابَ , (Ibn-'Abbád, K, TA,) and بَابَهُ, (TA in art, عتب,) aor.
سَكَفَ , (K,) I did not tread, or have not trodden, upon the threshold of the door, (Ibn-'Abbád, K, TA,) and of his door; (TA;) as also ↓ ما تَسَكَّفْتُهُ : (K:) and لَهُ بَابًا ↓ لَا أَتَسَكَّفُ [I will not tread upon the threshold of a door of his; or] I will not enter a house, or chamber, of his. (Z, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
